ACTIVE.concurrency: Protected by initLock to prevent race-condition key generation

REVOCATION.mechanism: revokeAuthorityState() resets all internal cryptographic material to NULL
REVOCATION.trigger: Explicit rotation request, system reset, or process termination

RESTART.behavior: Deterministic invalidation of all existing seal tokens (New secret generates non-matching tags for old bindings)

staleBindingHandling.validation: verifyHMACSealToken rejects tokens matching old key versions or previous process secrets
